headline: Mercado Pago Temporarily Suspends Crypto Operations Due to Instability
summary: Mercado Pago suspended cryptocurrency transfers due to system instability, notifying users that digital asset transfers are temporarily unavailable and deposits may experience delays.
why: Operational disruptions on major fintech platforms impact retail crypto liquidity and digital asset accessibility.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrencies
impacts.why: Platform service outages restrict immediate retail trading access for digital assets.
